subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECT operating system used in computers and laptops.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Android**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Android** is primarily an **operating system for mobile devices**, such as smartphones and tablets, rather than a dedicated operating system for computers and laptops.
 
• Android was developed by **Google** and is based on a modified version of the **Linux kernel** and other open-source software.
 
• Although Android can technically run on laptops or desktops using emulators or custom setups, it is not commonly used for such purposes and is not a mainstream operating system for computers.
 
• In contrast, **Linux, Windows, and Unix** are widely recognized operating systems for computers and laptops, designed for diverse computing needs, including personal, professional, and server-based tasks.
 
• **Linux**, **Windows**, and **Unix** are highly versatile and support a wide range of hardware configurations,
